actual.theorem: For H_d(t,J)=H(t)-JQ+(V/2)d(t)J^2 I, every target-blind C2 d leaves H_d(t,0)=H(t) and partial_J H_d(t,0)=-Q. The scalar contact factors exactly from the partition function, so with F_beta=-beta^-1 log Z the helicity-like curvature +V^-1 partial_J^2 F_beta shifts by +d(t). The same c-number shift moves +V^-1 partial_J^2 E_0 by +d(t) wherever the ground branch is stable.

actual.artifact_policy: Every ref has exact path, sha256, role and media_type fields; path must be normalized repository-relative POSIX, contain no embedded NUL, have at most 4096 characters, use exact case-sensitive on-disk segment spelling, contain no segment ending in a space or dot, exist now, round-trip exactly through resolved repository-relative POSIX spelling, match its normalized SHA-256, and satisfy its role-specific root, suffix and media-type policy.
